Description:
[center]I'm sorry I have taken a step back from modding, I have not been intentionally ignoring everyone! I have been devoting all of my spare time to developing my own game! 

Obviously, my game has no relevance to this mod, but nevertheless I feel I should at least showcase why I have been absent for so long. 

Introducing; [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4458750/Wardens_of_Wen/]Wardens of Wen, available on Steam now[/url]!

Once my game has had it's full release and I have less personal pressure I plan to get back to modding once again! Thank you for your interest in my mod, and for your patience![/center]

[b][color=#93c47d][size=3]Welcome! What started as a small little mod that allowed players to do something with the Barn Bears' Jar of Honey from SVE evolved into much more!﻿ With 4 New Locations, 7 New Basic NPCs, 6 Custom Machines, 6 New Crops, 26 New Drinks, 5 New Cooking Recipes, 4 New Forages, 11 New Buffs, and 2 New Shops!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/UG3ZCqB.png[/img]
Starting from the beginning of your save, you have access to Nat's Shop who will sell you new custom crops - according to their respective season. These crops are;
﻿
Barley (Spring) - Rum
Buckwheat (Spring/Summer) - Whiskey
Millet (Summer) - Sake
Oat (Spring) - Bourbon
Rye (Summer/Fall) - Vodka
and Sorghum (Spring/Summer) - Tequila﻿
[img]https://i.imgur.com/aya6q3G.png[/img]﻿﻿[/size][/color]
[/b][color=#93c47d][size=3][b]You can learn to brew many ways!

Once you ship any of the custom crops, you will get a mail from Zach informing you he now can sell the recipe for the Distillery! This Distillery will allow you to turn these new crops into delicious alcoholic spirits!

At Farming level 4, you will learn the recipe for the Artisanal Mead Keg and the Aging Vat. This Keg can be used to turn your Vanilla Honey, or your SVE Jar of Honey into Mead!

The Aging Vat can be used to age and infuse your Mead!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/YTIbbsS.png[/img]﻿﻿﻿
Once you ship your first Mead, you will receive another letter in the mail from the friendly Bartender, instructing you how to Age your Mead in an Aging Vat to increase its flavor profile and price even more! Using 2 of any 3 fruit the Aging Vat will apply those flavors to your mead, and age it over time! The combination possibilities are endless!

After shipping any basic Spirit, you will also be able to purchase a Spirit Infuser recipe from Zach to infuse your spirits with 2 of any fruit to apply the flavor to it, increasing the price even further!

(The Artisanal Mead Keg and the Aging Vat both have Machine Progression System support if enabled)
[img]https://i.imgur.com/xUmiadd.png[/img]﻿
Once you ship him an Aged Honey Mead, Zach will tell you all about the next steps, which include smoking the aged mead in a custom Barrel Smoker, and let you know he is now selling the recipe for you to pick up!

You can also smoke any of your basic and aged spirits, meads, and ciders!
﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/yjxiVzi.png[/img]﻿﻿﻿
Additionally, once you ship Aged Mead for the first time you will receive a letter in the mail from the Bartender's Wife explaining that you can also come by and purchase the blueprints of the Carbonator from her to mead delicious bubbly Ciders!﻿[/b][/size][/color]

[size=3]An alternative to Aging, another Stage Two machine is The Carbonator! This machine has multiple recipes. The First being the ability to create Sparkling Mead in the same fashion you would Age them in the preserving Jar. 2x of any 3x Fruit plus one Standard Honey Mead gets you a deliciously crafted Sparkling Honey Mead! The second uses an Empty Bottles and 5x of any Fruit to brew up a delicious Cider! These Ciders cannot be aged, but they can be Smoked!﻿
